title: Device reboot then cold start: no auto-resume, the persisted Parked host boots as parked_resume and recovers on the first foreground

preconditions.notes: The host parked cleanly (epoch closed, level-2 durable) before the device rebooted. No process survives the reboot, and nothing may resume work before the user opens the app.

timeline.detail: admission closed, WAL durable, WebContent stopped, no work scheduled
no lifecycle callback reaches the parked host and no work is resumed at boot
process start with a persisted Parked host: boot disposition parked_resume, admission closed
the boot transition carries the parked_resume reason and enters Recovering

timeline.event: overlay pack, worker boot, WAL replay
timeline.detail: every mutation above the materialized watermark is replayed; the manifest boot id no longer matches the process

notes: Two boot shapes exist and a runner must distinguish them: no persisted state is cold_start with reason empty_workspace, and a persisted non-Failed host is crash_recovery or parked_resume. surfaced_to_user is unmeasured: the Android boot notification and next-launch banner are plan items, and Android 15 does not allow starting a dataSync foreground service from BOOT_COMPLETED, so the runner must not assume one.
